primaryText.summary: The main stair tower has an exposed north elevation with stepped casement windows, offset buttresses, string courses and a heightened parapet. Attached east/west/south wings have tiled gables; the west range includes projecting canted bays and the east has an entrance plus a short low connector to a separate hall. Current upper plaster/roof detail is restored. These facts guide explicit estimated parts, not surveyed plans.

sourceDimensions.source: Existing Qualla story, descriptive scale only

wholeScope: Whole surviving tower with physically attached lower house/west/east/south ranges and intrinsic bays/porch/short low hall-link connector. Use actual eight native outer controls. Tall tower position/roof parts within envelope are explicit photographic/listing-text estimates. Separate modern named CanonburyHouse, school/KingEdwardHall, terraces, detached garden houses, vanished pond/gardens, site pad/fences and interiors excluded.
